summary: Full-stack regression on fresh workspace import. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed against public preview URL (waitlist CRUD + validation + dedupe case-insensitive + count integrity + brand/earth binary shape 4,718,592 B + brand/logo expected 503 + brand/unknown 404 + origin cache-control). Frontend @390x844: hero, drawn-logo fallback, 3D textured globe, menu overlay nav, real-wheel scroll through all 4 sections, waitlist open/submit success (position #6)/duplicate (already_joined title)/close via button and backdrop, audience selector, card flip, final section count text all working. Only 2 console errors (expected 503s for /api/brand/logo). No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly uses async motor + Pydantic + API prefix + GZip + CORS; waitlist dedupe implemented via unique email index + DuplicateKeyError (case-normalized via .lower().strip()).

brand_assets.py read-only, allowlisted, handles storage_key refresh on 503 and returns proper Cache-Control. Expected 503 for 'logo' is a storage-tenant gap (asset lives in prior account), not a code bug; frontend correctly falls back to the drawn Wordmark.

All interactive components expose testID; no React Native deprecated packages (no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch); all text wrapped in <Text/>; styles via StyleSheet.create across components.
seed_data_creation: Added ~2 TEST_ waitlist entries during FE submit test (success + duplicate flows). Multiple TEST_ entries created by pytest; final count observed = 6.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is in /app/frontend/.env as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. /api/brand/logo returning 503 is EXPECTED by this problem statement — do NOT regress tests expecting a 200 PNG. Earth asset is 1536*768*4 = 4,718,592 bytes. Waitlist flow uses real mouse wheel scroll (not scrollTo on landing-scroll which is unreliable in automation). Backend test updated to assert 503 on /api/brand/logo accordingly.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs reproduced. The pre-existing test_brand_assets.py was expecting /api/brand/logo=200 PNG which conflicted with the agreed-upon expected behavior (logo asset lives in prior account storage). Updated test to assert 503 to match the spec in the review request; frontend fallback to drawn Wordmark verified visible in all hero screenshots.
